w: Sector Los Angeles, Submerged Land Act (SLA)
d: Alcatel Submarine Networks Marine will conduct submarine telecommunications cable installation activities for Segment 6 of the ORCA Project from Hermosa Beach, California, to the offshore end of Segment 6 from August 24 through October 16, 2026. Operations will include route clearance, shore-end cable landing, cable burial, surface cable laying, and ROV operations along the cable route between 33.871435, -118.418618 and 37.387200, -128.266290. The C/S Ile de Sein will be engaged in these operations and will maintain a continuous listening watch on VHF-FM Channel 16. The vessel may be restricted in its ability to maneuver during certain phases of the work. For more information, contact the Master of C/S Ile de Sein at +47 23 67 48 00 or Luc Parkinson at +33 6 48 93 46 48. Mariners are urged to transit at their slowest safe speed to minimize wake and proceed with caution after passing arra

A long-distance open-water swim will be conducted in the Pacific Ocean along the California coast from San Luis Obispo County to the Orange/San Diego County line from September 2026 to December 2026. The swim will occur periodically, as weather and sea conditions permit.

The swimmer will be accompanied by a designated support vessel that will remain in the immediate vicinity.

For more details or comments, mariners may monitor the live tracker at https://zerosixzero.com/catherinebreed/swim-california. All mariners are advised to transit the area with caution.

w: Sector Los Angeles, Submerged Land Act (SLA)
d:
Aqueos Corporation will be conducting underwater pipeline inspection work for Exxon Mobil from September 27 to October 27, 2026. Operations will be conducted at Platform Holly and the Seep Tents at approximately 34.38986, -119.90604.

The operations will be conducted on a 24-hour basis by the OSV Loren C (Call Sign: WDP 2092) using a Remote Operated Vehicle (ROV) in "live boat" mode. The vessel is 225 feet LOA with a red hull and white superstructure, and will monitor VHF Channel 16. Mariners are requested to use caution when transiting near the operation.

For more details or comments, contact Greg Garnett at (808) 476-1556 or the vessel directly at (562) 768-8282. All mariners are advised to transit the area with caution.
